CustomField.label: Formula Result Type
CustomField.description: Declares the data type your formulas return. It applies to all single-value formulas in this check - "Value to find in the list (formula)" and "Expected Value (Formula)", which affect pass/fail, as well as "Display: Found Formula" and "Display: Expected Formula", which are display only. Leave "Auto" unless you know the return type; declaring it saves formula calls, but "Auto" always resolves correctly. Choices: "Auto", "Checkbox", "Number", "Date", "Date/Time", "Text".
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The type your formulas return. Applies to every formula in the check (the list/expected value formulas and the display formulas). Leave "Auto" unless you know the type - "Auto" always works but uses more formula calls.
